-- Tema vermelho (adicionado)
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    if player then
        local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        local DARK_RED = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 0)

        local function applyRed(obj)
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3 = DARK_RED
                end
                if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                    obj.TextColor3 = RED
                end
                if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                    obj.Color = RED
                end
                if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    obj.ImageColor3 = RED
                end
                if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    obj.BorderColor3 = RED
                end
            end)
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
            applyRed(obj)
        end
        gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(applyRed)
    end
end
